audit.whatIsWrong: The packet's own defect list says 'level chart contradicts data: Poppy wins 55.16% but the chart gives Maokai 5/7 stages vs 0', and the audited maokai__poppy mirror pushed rows 2 through 6 to Maokai — the exact rows whose whys on this side say Poppy wins them (level 2 wall-stun he cannot dash out of, level 3 'one of your strongest windows', 4-5 percent-HP Q beating his health bar, level 6 R peel, first item 'sit on him').
audit.why: Following the mirror would mean rewriting five whys to invent a Maokai power shift that neither the win rate nor the written analysis supports; leaving it means my chart and the mirror disagree and mirror-fix.js decides. Either choice is a judgement call about which source is authoritative, so I made no row flips and escalated instead.
audit.corrected: No chart edits. Question recorded for the user.

audit.why: Four spikes present and correctly owned — levels 2-3, level 6 as peel rather than burst, first item, and late tilting to Maokai's teamfight utility.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions are absent. Maokai is untargetable for the whole of Twisted Advance, and the page tells you to fight around it without saying so. And Bramble Smash knocks back, while Keeper's Verdict is a channel — his Q cancels your 140-second ultimate, which nothing on the page mentions.
audit.why: Burst spent into an untargetable dash is burst thrown away, and a Poppy who opens R inside his 600-range Q loses the ultimate outright.
audit.corrected: Untargetability stated in spikes[1] and wants.foe[0]; the Q-cancels-R interaction stated in phases[4].why and dontsFull[2].d. Real cooldowns added: his Twisted Advance is 14s at rank 1 against your Steadfast Presence at 20s, which is why W is for his engage and nothing else.

audit.why: Sap Magic heals him off basic attacks and the item line already calls for anti-heal from a Thornmail component early.

edits.before: W deletes his dash mid-flight — hold it like a parry. Only take the trade when Maokai's Twisted Advance is down.
edits.after: W stops Twisted Advance mid-dash and grounds him. Trade when it is down — 14s at rank 1, and he is immobile without it.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Twisted Advance's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Hold W for Twisted Advance — yours is 20s at rank 1 against his 14s, so spend it on his engage and never on poke or the wave.

edits.before: Keeper’s Verdict punts the fight’s biggest threat across the map. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Maokai's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Never open Keeper's Verdict inside Bramble Smash's 600 range: the knockback cancels the channel, and a 140s ultimate with it.

edits.before: E-ing with no wall behind him — the wall-stun is the whole trade; the dash alone is a tickle.
edits.after: His Q knockback cancels Keeper's Verdict — never open that channel inside his 600 range.

edits.before: R is a peel/disengage that cancels his W root engage and saves you from a gank, not a burst spike.
edits.after: Untargetable mid-Twisted Advance: hold burst till he lands. R peels the root engage, not a burst spike.

edits.before: Land his W root to lock you in place and bonk you with Q before you reach a wall
edits.after: Go untargetable with W, root you on arrival, and Q you off before you reach a wall

notes: The level chart is the one thing I would not decide alone here — see questionsForUser. Everything else on this page is sound: Maokai is correctly described as immobile-once-W-is-down, and the anti-heal call is already present. dosFull[1].t 'Dodge his W root' and dontsFull[1].t 'Fight in saplings' are under 25 characters so the applier skips them; note that dontsFull[2].t reads 'Eat his R knockback' but the knockback is Bramble Smash (Q) — Nature's Grasp roots, it does not knock back. That title is 19 characters and cannot be fixed through a normal edit.
